In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 9.
